name: tarteaucitron.io – Cookie Banner & GDPR Consent Management
author: Amauri

sections.description:
tarteaucitron.io is a French consent management platform (CMP) that helps you manage cookies and third-party services on your WordPress website.

Display a customizable cookie consent banner, let visitors accept or reject services, and manage their preferences from a dedicated consent panel.

The plugin connects your WordPress website to the tarteaucitron.io Pro service, with automatic detection of supported services, over 50 ready-to-use design themes, an online configuration dashboard and consent statistics.

A 7-day trial is available without a credit card. A paid tarteaucitron.io license is required after the trial. All licenses include unlimited websites and unlimited traffic.

Cookie consent management for GDPR / RGPD

Give visitors control over the third-party services used on your website.

  • Display a cookie banner and a consent preferences panel.
  • Offer accept-all and reject-all buttons.
  • Let visitors manage consent for individual services.
  • Allow visitors to reopen the panel and change their preferences.
  • Keep supported services requiring consent blocked until permission is granted when explicit consent is configured.

tarteaucitron.io helps you implement the consent controls needed for your GDPR compliance process. Your website’s compliance also depends on its configuration, the services you use and the information you provide to visitors.

Over 50 ready-to-use cookie banner themes

Choose from a collection of over 50 professionally designed themes available with tarteaucitron.io Pro.

Adapt your consent interface to your website’s visual identity without writing CSS or modifying your WordPress theme.

  • Minimalist and modern designs.
  • Accessibility-focused themes, including high-contrast and comfortable reading options.
  • Industry-specific themes for restaurants, hotels, healthcare, education, real estate and more.
  • Sports, nature, creative and retro-inspired themes.
  • Seasonal and event-specific designs.

Each theme provides a consistent visual experience across the cookie banner, consent preferences panel, service details, cookie lists and permanent consent icon.

Accept-all and reject-all buttons use matching colors across the theme collection.

Themes are included with the Pro service at no additional cost and can be changed directly from your tarteaucitron.io dashboard.

Explore and test the cookie banner themes

Automatic detection of supported services

Simplify installation with automatic detection of supported third-party services.

Manage analytics, advertising, embedded videos, maps, social media and other third-party integrations through tarteaucitron.io.

Check your website after setup to confirm that the services you use are detected and behave correctly before and after consent.

Automatic detection covers supported integrations. Custom scripts and unsupported integrations may require additional configuration.

Google Consent Mode v2

tarteaucitron.io supports Google Consent Mode v2 to communicate visitors’ consent choices to compatible Google tags.

Both Basic and Advanced Consent Mode configurations are supported.

Configure consent settings for your Google integrations and verify their behavior with your analytics and advertising setup.

Consent Mode complements consent collection: it does not replace the cookie banner or the need to configure your tags correctly.

Customize your cookie banner

Adapt the consent interface to your website from the tarteaucitron.io online dashboard.

  • Choose from over 50 predefined design themes.
  • Customize banner and button colors when using the default theme.
  • Edit the texts shown to visitors.
  • Configure the banner position and layout.
  • Configure consent options and service settings.
  • Preview your changes.

Switch between predefined themes or customize the default design to match your website.

Accessibility settings

Use a consent interface designed with accessibility in mind, with options for the panel’s position in the document and a link to reopen consent preferences.

Dedicated accessibility-focused themes are available, including high-contrast, compact and comfortable reading layouts.

When customizing the banner, maintain readable text, sufficient color contrast and usable controls.

Consent statistics

View consent statistics in your tarteaucitron.io dashboard to understand how visitors interact with your consent choices.

Manage your consent configuration and statistics for multiple websites from a single account.

Unlimited websites and unlimited traffic

All tarteaucitron.io Pro licenses include unlimited websites and unlimited traffic.

Use the same license across multiple WordPress installations, domains and projects without additional per-website or per-pageview charges.

This makes tarteaucitron.io suitable for individual website owners, developers, agencies and organizations managing multiple websites.

Annual, multi-year and lifetime licenses are available, with no automatic renewal.

French consent management platform

tarteaucitron.io is an independent French consent management platform with infrastructure hosted in France.

The service is built around the tarteaucitron.js open-source project, maintained since 2014.

Pro service and open-source library

This WordPress plugin integrates the tarteaucitron.io Pro service. It is available with a 7-day trial without a credit card and requires a paid license after that period.

The tarteaucitron.js JavaScript library is also available separately as a free, open-source project for manual integration. Its availability does not make the Pro service included with this plugin free.

Learn more about tarteaucitron.io

Explore the cookie banner themes

View the open-source project on GitHub
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  2. Search for tarteaucitron.io.
  3. Install and activate the plugin.
  4. Open Settings > tarteaucitron.io and follow the instructions to connect your website to the service.
  5. Choose a predefined theme or customize your banner from the tarteaucitron.io dashboard.
  6. Configure your texts, services and consent settings.
  7. Test your website before consent, after acceptance and after rejection.

You can also upload the tarteaucitronjs folder to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.
sections.faq:
What is a CMP?

A consent management platform (CMP) helps a website collect and manage visitors’ choices about cookies and third-party services.

tarteaucitron.io provides a cookie banner, a consent preferences panel and tools to configure supported services.

Is this WordPress plugin free to use?

The plugin is free to download and connects your website to the tarteaucitron.io Pro service.

You can try the service for 7 days without providing a credit card. A paid license is required to continue using the service after the trial.

All Pro licenses include unlimited websites, unlimited traffic and access to the full theme collection.

What is the difference between this plugin and tarteaucitron.js?

tarteaucitron.js is the free, open-source JavaScript library, available for manual integration.

This plugin connects WordPress to tarteaucitron.io Pro, which adds automatic detection of supported services, online configuration, ready-to-use design themes and consent statistics.

Does tarteaucitron.io support GDPR and RGPD consent requirements?

tarteaucitron.io helps you implement cookie and third-party service consent controls for the GDPR, known as RGPD in French.

Installing a CMP alone does not guarantee that an entire website is compliant. Review your service configuration, privacy information and the behavior of your website before and after consent.

Does it support Google Consent Mode v2?

Yes. tarteaucitron.io supports both Basic and Advanced Google Consent Mode v2 for communicating consent choices to compatible Google tags.

You still need to configure your Google services correctly and check that their behavior matches your chosen consent settings.

Does automatic detection cover every script on my website?

Automatic detection handles supported services. Custom scripts, modified integrations or unsupported services may need additional configuration.

Test the actual behavior of your website after installation, including services added through other plugins or a tag manager.

Can visitors reject cookies or change their choices?

Yes. You can display accept-all and reject-all buttons and let visitors manage their preferences for individual services.

Visitors can reopen the consent panel to review or change their choices.

Can I customize the banner?

Yes. You can customize colors, texts and consent options from the tarteaucitron.io online dashboard.

You can also choose from over 50 predefined design themes without writing any CSS.

Keep accessibility in mind when changing colors, wording and controls.

Are cookie banner themes included in the Pro license?

Yes. All predefined themes are included with tarteaucitron.io Pro at no additional cost.

Themes customize the entire consent interface, not just the cookie banner. You can switch between themes directly from your online dashboard.

Test the available themes in our interactive demonstration

Do cookie banner themes work with any WordPress theme?

The consent interface is independent of your WordPress theme.

The predefined designs can be used without changing your WordPress theme or its CSS. As with any third-party integration, check the visual appearance and behavior on your website after configuration.

Can I use one license for multiple WordPress websites?

Yes. All tarteaucitron.io Pro licenses include unlimited websites and unlimited traffic.

There is no need to purchase a separate license for each WordPress installation or domain.

Is there a monthly pageview limit?

No. tarteaucitron.io Pro licenses include unlimited traffic, with no monthly pageview quota.

Does my license renew automatically?

No. tarteaucitron.io licenses do not renew automatically. Lifetime licenses are also available.

Where is tarteaucitron.io hosted?

The tarteaucitron.io service infrastructure is hosted in France.

Where do I manage my settings?

Use Settings > tarteaucitron.io in WordPress for the plugin’s connection settings.

Manage your banner configuration, design themes and consent statistics through your tarteaucitron.io account.
